title: SNES soft stack silently overlaps static data (dither -O3 never writes its gate CRC)
attribution: Claude Code 2.1.286 (claude --version), model Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), high reasoning effort (T4 design-and-build agent definition; effort not readable from session metadata); session session_01Skyq488smgqkyyzHrcCX7F. summary: examples/snes/dither.c built with the SDK driver at -O3 (LTO) never writes corpus_result (0x0000 against 0x80C4) in default mosw65816 and +mos-a16, on bsnes-jg and MAME; -O2 passes. There is no miscompile: the same -O3 instruction stream passes when only the data layout changes. Cause: the SNES platform (platforms/snes/link.ld) puts the soft stack at $2000, growing down into the same low-WRAM region as .bss/.noinit, with no reservation or check. The demo's static data ends at $1FAD (82 B free). At -O3 the pre-link inliner (threshold 250; opt-bisect pass 4016, inline on main) inlines dither_gate_crc and its three unrolled ds_dither calls into main, adding six [66 x i16] locals. main makes 7 indirect calls, so MOSNonReentrant never marks it nonreentrant and its 313 B frame (353 B with +mos-a16) goes on the soft stack at [$1EC7,$2000). The frame overlaps dither_gate_crc.out[478..575] and the whole .noinit static stack. The gate's out[] stores in row 21 overwrite main's spilled row counter and row pointer, and the loop livelocks. Reproduces with upstream llc 06bc967d2668 on the same IR and with an unpatched upstream clang 742d554bf080 full build using this repo's SNES SDK. Placing main's frame on the static stack turns it into a link error (.noinit overflowed by 181 bytes). An earlier instance (rdiff, e3bb5a62, 2026-09-25) was fixed in the demo without a record or guard. Fix location: our SNES platform (a link-time soft-stack reservation and assertion) and/or the differential gate (a soft-SP low-water check); an optional upstream MOSNonReentrant enhancement; not 0002, the #320/#321 patches or generic LLVM. Not fixed; the guard policy is a user decision.

prior_work.source_assessment: No patch or live-source change covers this. MOSNonReentrant.cpp (upstream code, untouched by 0002 and 0038 in the relevant analysis) adds a calls-external to external-calling edge, so main, which has external linkage and makes indirect calls, is never norecurse and MOSFrameLowering::usesStaticStack keeps its frame on the soft stack. platforms/snes*/link.ld and the installed link.ld (sha256 9eb48681...) set __stack = 0x2000 in the ram region shared with .bss/.noinit and reserve or assert nothing. No upstream llvm-mos-sdk platform script reserves or asserts a soft-stack size.
prior_work.binary_assessment: The installed clang-23 254624ba..., lld c89b04cb..., llc cf5355d3... and mos-snes.cfg f12c5b6a... are the report's identities and reproduce its four ROM hashes byte for byte. Upstream llc 321-00 (2f5c1768..., equals frozen-llc.sha256, upstream 06bc967d2668) and unpatched upstream clang 742d554b (b48000f5..., manifest unpatched, empty tracked diff) fail the same way, so no downstream patch is involved.
prior_work.decision: New canonical record for the SNES soft-stack/static-data collision. mos-native-width-pressure-sets only recorded the sighting; its pressure-set change is not involved, since every llc variant and plain mosw65816 fail. reentrant-attribute-contract concerns the frontend reentrant attribute contract, not a resource overlap. The rdiff fix e3bb5a62 is an earlier, unrecorded instance of the same platform mechanism, now covered here.

root_cause.defect_class: platform resource contract (silent soft-stack overflow into static data); not a code-generation error
root_cause.function: main (with dither_gate_crc and three unrolled ds_dither copies inlined)
root_cause.pass: pre-link CGSCC inliner, -O3 threshold 250 (opt-bisect 4016: inline on (main)); frame placement by MOSNonReentrant / MOSFrameLowering::usesStaticStack
root_cause.construct: two [66 x i16] locals per inlined ds_dither, colored to 2 x 132 B, plus 49 B of spills: a 313 B soft-stack frame against 82 B of headroom
causal_checks: Reordered data layout (tools/reorder-ld.py), identical instruction stream (0 of 9573 / 8839 instructions differ after masking $ operands): PASS in both modes on bsnes-jg and MAME
main marked norecurse in the -O3 IR: frame moves to the static stack and the link fails (.noinit overflowed by 181 bytes)
Latch trace (tools/jgxlatch.cpp): row 21 out[] stores reset the spilled row counter to 2/3 and the row pointer to $1E03; livelock
Host oracle and whole demo at gcc -O3 with ASan+UBSan: clean, results equal the -O2 oracle
__attribute__((nonreentrant)) main in a copy of dither.c: -O2 builds and passes, -O3 fails to link (.noinit overflowed by 181 bytes)
proposed_fix: Differential gate (ours): record the soft stack pointer low-water mark on bsnes-jg and fail below __heap_start (implemented 2026-10-01; see guard)

SNES platform (ours, platforms/snes*/link.ld): reserve soft-stack space and ASSERT __heap_start + reserve <= __stack; the reserve size is a policy decision (any value of 83 B or more also rejects the passing -O2 dither build)
Optional upstream llvm-mos enhancement (MOSNonReentrant.cpp): exclude a non-address-taken main from the indirect-call recursion edge, making this overflow a loud link error
Per-program source guard available now: __attribute__((nonreentrant)) on main puts its frame on the static stack; dither then passes at -O2 and fails to link at -O3 (.noinit overflowed by 181 bytes)
Demo: dither -O3 needs 231 B (soft stack) or 181 B (static stack) more low WRAM; fits only by shrinking static data or keeping ds_dither out of line
root_cause.user_decision_needed: Which guard (gate check, link-time reserve, per-program nonreentrant main, or a combination), the reserve size, and whether dither -O3 must fit or is declared unsupported.

upstream.sdk_pr_415: The open upstream SNES target llvm-mos-sdk#415 (head e6a5c17cab52026cb66924a8e2bf5fab870536f2, read via the public API 2026-10-01) sets __stack = 0x0200, so its soft stack grows down into page 1 with the hardware stack; it has no soft-stack reservation or assertion either.

unknowns: The upstream clang run links this repo's SDK libc bitcode (with a data-layout warning for the p2/p3 address spaces); an entirely upstream toolchain+SDK run is impossible because upstream has no SNES platform. The harness -O3 builds in the o2-large run reported a wrong fold (0xA7D4) where this replay sees 0x0000 after 3000 frames; both fail and pass with the reordered layout here, and the exact corrupted value depends on the llc variant's layout.

mitigation_observation.status: demo mitigated; defect record open (platform guard is separate work)
mitigation_observation.summary: examples/snes/dither.c keeps its 2304 B frame buffer in high WRAM ($7E:2000) behind the WRAM data port instead of low WRAM. Static data now ends at $16AE, leaving 2386 B to __stack (was 82 B). The gate passes (0x80C4) at -O2 and -O3 in default, +mos-a16 and +mos-a16,+mos-xy16 on bsnes-jg, and on MAME for all six. Measured soft-stack depth: 279/286/286 B at -O2 and 313/353/356 B at -O3 (default/a16/xy16), so at least 2030 B stays untouched. -O2 master clocks fall (loop per frame -19.7% default, -26.2% a16, -34.2% a16xy16). The corpus slice object is byte-identical; -verify-machineinstrs is clean at -O2/-O3 (default, a16); the picture is pixel-identical at equal iteration count. Far pointers were rejected because they fail to legalize in default mosw65816.

guard.summary: build/jgxcheck records the lowest soft-stack pointer (__rc0/__rc1, committed when the __rc1 store lands) and fails the run when it is below the end of static data; bounds from <rom>.elf or the lld map. dev/stackguard-check.sh replays the committed dither -O3 ROM (231 B overlap, min SP $1EC7 against __heap_start $1FAE). guard.sweep: 608 runs (83 corpus programs x default/a16/xy16 at -Os, 359 demo-gate ROMs from 154 gates), measured on source 85f7972a (before the dither buffer move) with the pre-10:06 toolchain: no overlap. Smallest margins: dither 76 B (pre-move source), msquares 246 B, lsystem 577 B, vlastack 614 B, packrec 755 B. Deepest soft stacks: irqgate 569 B and dpbank 305 B (NMI handlers). No new violation, so no repeat sighting beyond the original dither -O3 build; rdiff (e3bb5a62) measures 1,060 B of margin at its current size.

link_reserve.status: implemented 2026-10-01 (second of the proposed guards); defect record stays open
link_reserve.summary: Every SNES linker script (platforms/snes, snes-far, snes-hirom, snes-exhirom, snes-gallery, and the scripts tools/snes-cartcanary.py emit-platform generates) carries PROVIDE(__soft_stack_min = 256) and ASSERT(__heap_start + __soft_stack_min <= __stack, 'soft-stack reserve violated: ...'). __heap_start is the end of .noinit, so of all static data in low WRAM; -Wl,--defsym=__soft_stack_min=N overrides it per link. N = 256 B was chosen by the user from the guard sweep (smallest gap of 279 programs: msquares 338 B).

link_reserve.why_open: The reserve bounds the STATIC side only: it proves nothing about frame depth, so a program with 300 B of room and 400 B of frames still overlaps silently (the runtime guard measures depth, in gated runs only; irqgate is 569 B deep). The dither -O3 inliner behaviour that made main's frame 313 B is unchanged (not a code-generation error per root_cause, and the demo was repaired by moving its buffers, 07f4fe2f). The schema's fixed status needs a candidate run that PASSES the same input; the link-time assert makes that input fail to link, so it is evidence of rejection, not of a repaired build. Left at confirmed; closing needs either a compile-time or link-time bound on soft-stack depth, or a decision that the contract is 'reserve plus gated runtime guard'.
